$comment: Hosts a skill may name or call. A host is allowed together with its subdomains. Anything else in a SKILL.md or a script is reported by tools/audit.mjs. Keep the reason next to every host.

hosts.tkbk.online: TKBK site, docs and MCP hub (mcp.tkbk.online, api.tkbk.online)
hosts.github.com: source of the skills and the MCP servers (tkbk-online/*)
hosts.raw.githubusercontent.com: raw files of the same repositories
hosts.npmjs.com: the skills CLI and MCP packages
hosts.wildberries.ru: Wildberries seller API (feedbacks-api, marketplace-api, seller-analytics-api, discounts-prices-api)
hosts.yandex.ru: Yandex Market partner API (api.partner.market.yandex.ru) and docs
hosts.bitrix24.ru: Bitrix24 cloud portals and REST docs
hosts.yoomoney.ru: YooKassa dashboard (yookassa.ru redirects here for some pages)
hosts.nalog.gov.ru: Federal Tax Service (54-FZ receipts, VAT rules)
hosts.openai.com: OpenAI SDK docs (OpenAI-compatible path of the TKBK gateway)
hosts.bigmodel.cn: Z.ai API and docs called by the official GLM skills (ZHIPUAI_API_KEY)
hosts.fonts.googleapis.com: web fonts linked from generated HTML reports (skill-creator)
hosts.fonts.gstatic.com: web fonts linked from generated HTML reports (skill-creator)
hosts.linear.app: Linear MCP server declared by the Codex linear skill
hosts.vercel.sh: Vercel deploy endpoint used by the Codex vercel-deploy skill (uploads your project to Vercel on purpose)

docs.$comment: Documentation hosts that imported skills link to in prose. Allowed so that the reports stay readable; a link cannot send anything anywhere.
